{{Lang|Tanchuan|zh= 探川}} is a Lollo Logistic NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}. After helping [[Yinyu]] dilemma, Tanchuan finds new motivation to continue their work.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
{{tx}}
----
;(Talk to again after helping Yinyu)
:'''Tanchuan''': I must thank you.
:{{DIcon}} What for?
:'''Tanchuan''': I saw how much the local girl you helped has blossomed. You know, the one named Yinyu. She's now a famous guide in Hongzhen.
:'''Tanchuan''': Her story doesn't have much to do with me, but I'm truly motivated by her growth.
:'''Tanchuan''': When Lollo Logistics decided to expand into Mt. Firmament, I volunteered for the job, only to run headlong into a bunch of messy problems.
:'''Tanchuan''': I even considered transferring back to Jinzhou or quitting altogether.
:'''Tanchuan''': But then I saw Yinyu making us locals proud and building herself quite a name as a guide.
:'''Tanchuan''': And it made me think, maybe I could ship Mt. Firmament's specialties to Jinzhou using Lollo Logistics and help local sellers reach new markets.
:'''Tanchuan''': I don't know if it will work, but Mt. Firmament is a different animal. Instead of sticking to traditional logistics services, it might be better to incorporate some local flavor.
:'''Tanchuan''': I won't be quitting anytime soon, at least.
{{Dialogue End}}
